column1: # content: the time defect and the predicted deviation of the integration of check GS-13 by IDA at rtol = 1e-12 as functions of the last 16 binary digits of the settled step size (check GS-20
column2: part (g)): the settled step size is replaced by h_base + phase 2^-64 for every 32nd of the 65536 values of the phase (h_base: the largest multiple of 2^-48 that is not larger than the settled step size of the integration ida_1e-12; the phases are all machine numbers of one period); the time defect is computed by repeated machine addition as IDA advances its time (column time_defect) and from the closed formula
column3: the sum over the units in the last place of the time of (number of settled steps that end at a time with this unit) x (step size minus the nearest multiple of the unit) (column time_defect_formula); the predicted deviation from the errors of the formulas of ida_1e-12 and this time defect
